t: The Cooke & Lewis Corfe lever on rose door handle pair in matt black offers a stylish, ergonomic design for modern interiors. Designed with an ergonomic grip, this fire-rated door handle adds comfort and durability. Fire rated for 30 and 60 minutes when fitted to a suitable door, it delivers safety without compromising on style. With a sleek screw-on rose for a clean, concealed fit, this handle is easy to install and built to withstand daily wear. Provides a sleek, contemporary look for your home.
